---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a SCIM modelling, collaboration or usability improvement
title: "Feature: "
labels: enhancement
---

## User need

Who needs this and what are they trying to accomplish?

## Example situation

Describe a concrete infrastructure, scenario-planning or human–AI collaboration use case using synthetic information.

## Proposed behaviour

What should the user be able to do?

## Model impact

Does this require a change to:

- [ ] Entity semantics
- [ ] Relationship semantics
- [ ] Dependency requirements
- [ ] Scenario operations
- [ ] Evidence or provenance
- [ ] View geometry or renderer
- [ ] Proposal/review operations
- [ ] Workspace persistence
- [ ] No canonical model change

Explain how the behaviour can be represented in portable text. Do not propose a visual-only meaning.

## Human–AI behaviour

How should an AI interpret, propose or explain this feature? What requires human review?

## Mobile and accessibility

How should the workflow work with touch, keyboard and screen readers?

## Privacy and security

Would this store or transmit infrastructure information, use an AI provider, add accounts or connect to an external system?

## Alternatives

What simpler approaches or existing SCIM capabilities were considered?

## Success measure

How will we know the feature improves modelling or decision-making?
